summary.text: Andrew Molitor is a Republican member of the New York State Assembly representing District 150, which he has represented since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election on the Republican and Conservative Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a prosecutor by profession.

paragraphs.text: Molitor's career experience includes working as a prosecutor and assistant district attorney in Chautauqua County.
As of 2025, he was affiliated with the Bar Association of Northern Chautauqua and the Chautauqua Family of Catholic Churches.
